description: The evidence contract's machine twin (reference/evidence_contract.md owns the semantics; tools/verify_claims.py is the one executable implementation). A claim's `evidence` is a list of items, each exactly one of four kinds, one item per source: never several sources joined in one string, never a re-rendered structure, never a `memory:` prefix. Every key here is a standard JSON Schema keyword, so the CLI's strict validator accepts it.

oneOf.description: A quote from a local file. VERIFIED when the quote (case-folded, in-order `...` gaps allowed, a leading `path:N:` or `N:` grep prefix stripped) occurs in the file; UNVERIFIED when the file is readable and lacks it or does not exist; UNCHECKED when the file cannot be read.

file.description: repository-relative or absolute path, optionally with :N or :N-M; the line range is reported, never decisive

quote.description: the file's raw bytes, copied verbatim; one source per item

oneOf.description: The stdout of a read-only git command from the allow-list (git grep, ls-files, ls-tree, log, show, branch, check-ignore, cat-file, rev-parse, diff --stat or --name-only, status --short), run without a shell from the repository root. VERIFIED when stdout holds the output, or when output is empty, stdout is empty and every pathspec the command names matches a tracked path. Any other command, a shell metacharacter, an unlisted flag or a timeout is UNCHECKED. One leading `git -C <dir>` (an existing repository-relative directory, where the command then runs) and `check-ignore --no-index` are allowed.

command.description: one git command, no pipe, redirect or substitution

output.description: a verbatim run of the command's stdout, or the empty string for an absent claim

oneOf.description: The owner's verbatim words. VERIFIED when an owner turn of the session transcript holds them (an AskUserQuestion answer is an owner turn when the item also carries its `question`; a runtime envelope is not), or when a row of the named task record holds them and still resolves. A delegate-recorded, missing or unresolved row, or an unreadable transcript, is UNCHECKED.

question.description: the AskUserQuestion question the owner answered; required when the quote is a picked option label

task.description: a task record id whose condition rows may hold the words when this session's transcript does not

oneOf.description: A quote from an external page. A fetched artifact (fetch_source.sh manifest) is checked like a file; without one the item is UNCHECKED.

url.description: the page the quote was read from

artifact.description: local path of the fetched bytes
